question: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

act_boss_sim.method: 整场模拟（docs/boss-sim.md）：boss 的血量、首招、开场能力和出招按怪物库和出招模型（本进阶），我方按现在的牌组、遗物和药水，每个样本洗牌后由求解器逐回合出牌，打到一方死亡；胜率经日志 boss 战验证集校准；选项的差 = 两个校准胜率之差，± 是配对标准误（差在两个标准误以内，模拟分不出高低）
act_boss_sim.limits: 格挡牌和防守能力牌的价值可能被低估（模拟策略跨回合的防守不如实际）；模拟的战斗比实际更确定，单张牌带来的差可能被放大（校准只把绝对胜率拉准）；随机药水不在模拟里；进场血量是投影的中位数，实际会有高低；离本幕 boss 还远时，现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多
act_boss_sim.low_win_rate: 当前牌组在模拟里多半打不过（原始胜率 0%，校准后的数不会低于 0.0%，0 胜的读数）：胜率的差信息少，各选项另给 boss 平均剩血（赢的样本算 0）和它的配对差；离 boss 还远时现在的牌组和到 boss 时的牌组差得多

run_constraints.requirement: V5没有固定牌数上限。按核心兑现、稀释、伤害/回合、升级替代及过渡存活权衡拿牌、跳牌和删牌；牌数不是目标，也不因达到30张而禁止获取。

facts.unknown_value_note: ?(数值未知) marks a number the mod does not expose; the text around it is accurate
facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-15T17:29:20，A10 共 265 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 265 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 76% (n=265)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 47% (n=202)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 5% (n=95)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。

run_plan.archetype: Flexible early offense and defense, favoring poison against Matriarch
run_plan.boss_prep: Secure reliable poison, efficient block, and impactful upgrades. Use sleeping turns for setup; preserve HP and potions against repeated Strength/Dexterity drains.
run_plan.summary: Starter output is inadequate. Prioritize immediate combat improvements, favor poison against Matriarch, and follow actual pack contents and rewards. Take supported elites; remove weak starters after replacements arrive, without targeting a fixed deck size.

construction.reason: No core is established and pack contents are unknown. Poison suits Matriarch's attribute drains, but immediate combat strength takes priority. Complete-core performance remains unknown.
construction.pivot_if: Commit toward P with reliable poison and defensive support; favor S with shiv supply and payoff, D with multiple Footworks, or R after acquiring a discard relic.

answer.ranking_override_reason: Only Injury was modeled; neither alternative's benefit was evaluated. That ranking cannot compare Scroll Box's early development with the elite relic.
